newsitem.title: UK: SEPT BRENT SYSTEM THROUGHPUT SLIGHTLY LOWER - SHELL.
newsitem.headline: SEPT BRENT SYSTEM THROUGHPUT SLIGHTLY LOWER - SHELL.

text.p: Brent system operator Shell Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) on Thursday estimated North Sea Brent crude system throughput in September at 402,582 barrels per day (bpd), slightly lower than the 407,800 bpd pumped in August.
Average Brent pipeline throughput in the 12 months to the end of July was 431,971 bpd, Shell said.
Shell Expro is a joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Exxon Corp.

Brent system throughput includes crude produced from 13 fields and several satellite wells piped to the Sullom Voe terminal in the Shetland Islands, where it is blended with Ninian crude and exported as Brent Blend.
Shell Expro said the throughput forecast was subject to the progress of maintenance work, associated engineering and normal operational considerations and may be "subject to significant fluctuation".
